development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: Exact source and build verified only. Opt-in 256x144 real native GPU diagnostic crop; no runtime proof of visible menu, car or race, native complete frame, or HMD stereo.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Original D3D9 game Draw/Present, DX9Ex fallback, gamepad/FFB/SkyGlow and frozen DXVK unaffected; positive RGB data retained, pending GPU fence not reused, failed Map/query quarantined.

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: When a real native source Draw finishes GPU readback with zero RGB delta, same-Present staging is safely released for a subsequent real source Draw, up to two re-arms.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Pending GPU EVENT, wrong source serial, invalid mapped pitch or COM/device failure cannot re-arm; a genuine positive RGB capture is held for its matched Present. Alpha-only change is RGB-inert.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: Game D3D9 Draw and Present source serial, D3D11 pre/post copy, native typed readback RGB comparison, opt-in tile presentation and five exact-SHA push Actions gates all linked by real source code.

feature_contract.goal: Permit the original game's later native D3D11 Draw to yield an authentic visible RGB diagnostic tile when the initial same-Present draw produced zero RGB, without overwriting positive pixels or reusing in-flight GPU resources.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Verified completed RGB-inert capture can be released for a later native draw in the same original game Present.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: GPU fence, mapped resource bounds, original D3D9 renderer
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Positive RGB remains owned; pending/failed GPU copy does not mutate original game output or original input path.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: GitHub Actions Windows build, OpenXR and render source tests
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: The unchanged five mandatory push Gate workflows pass on the same final material result SHA.
